description: This file defines a DeepLinks handler and related policies for an macOS application, including deep link validation, delivery decisions, and UI prompts for execution.

classes.name: DeepLinkHandler
classes.description: Singleton class managing deep link handling, validation, and user prompts.

methods.name: handle(url:)
methods.description: Main entry point to process an incoming URL, parsing and delegating based on route.

methods.name: handleAgent(link:originalURL:)
methods.description: Processes agent deep links, including validation, confirmation prompts, and sending commands.

methods.name: currentKey()
methods.description: Retrieves the current deep link secret key for standard use.

methods.name: currentCanvasKey()
methods.description: Returns an ephemeral key used for in-app Canvas deep links.

methods.name: expectedKey()
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a persistent key stored in user defaults.

methods.name: generateRandomKey()
methods.description: Generates a fresh random key for in-memory use.

methods.name: confirm(title:message:)
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog to the user.

methods.name: presentAlert(title:message:)
methods.description: Displays an informational alert to the user.
